{
  "ClassName": "Decal",
  "Namespace": "Sandbox",
  "Title": "Decal",
  "Description": "The Decal component projects textures onto model's opaque or transparent surfaces. They inherit and modify the PBR properties of the surface they're projected on.",
  "Group": "Rendering",
  "Icon": "lens_blur",
  "BaseType": "Component",
  "Properties": [
    {
      "Name": "Decals",
      "Title": "Decals",
      "Description": null,
      "Type": "List<DecalDefinition>",
      "Group": null,
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "LifeTime",
      "Title": "Life Time",
      "Description": "How long should this decal live for?",
      "Type": "ParticleFloat",
      "Group": null,
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "Looped",
      "Title": "Looped",
      "Description": "If true then the decal will repeat itself forever",
      "Type": "Boolean",
      "Group": null,
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "Transient",
      "Title": "Transient",
      "Description": "If true then this decal will automatically get removed when maxdecals are exceeded. This is good for things like bullect impacts, where you want to keep them around for as long as possible but also don't want to have an unlimited amount of them hanging around. Note that while the component will be destroyed, you probably want a TemporaryEffect component on the GameObject to make sure it all gets fully deleted.",
      "Type": "Boolean",
      "Group": null,
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "Size",
      "Title": "Size",
      "Description": "A 2D size of the decal in world units.",
      "Type": "Vector2",
      "Group": null,
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "Scale",
      "Title": "Scale",
      "Description": "Scale the width and height by this value",
      "Type": "ParticleFloat",
      "Group": null,
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "Rotation",
      "Title": "Rotation",
      "Description": "Rotation angle of the decal in degrees",
      "Type": "ParticleFloat",
      "Group": null,
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "Depth",
      "Title": "Depth",
      "Description": "The depth of the decal in world units. This is how far the decal extends into the surface it is projected onto.",
      "Type": "Single",
      "Group": null,
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "Parallax",
      "Title": "Parallax",
      "Description": "Parallax depth strength of the decal",
      "Type": "ParticleFloat",
      "Group": null,
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "ColorTint",
      "Title": "Color Tint",
      "Description": "Tints the color of the decal's albedo and can be used to adjust the overall opacity of the decal.",
      "Type": "ParticleGradient",
      "Group": null,
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "ColorMix",
      "Title": "Color Mix",
      "Description": "Controls the opacity of the decal's color texture without reducing the impact of the normal or rmo texture. Set to 0 to create a normal/rmo only decal masked by the color textures alpha.",
      "Type": "ParticleFloat",
      "Group": null,
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "AttenuationAngle",
      "Title": "Attenuation Angle",
      "Description": "Attenuation angle controls how much the decal fades at an angle. At 0 it does not fade at all. Up to 1 it fades the most.",
      "Type": "Single",
      "Group": null,
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "CoverageAmount",
      "Title": "Coverage Amount",
      "Description": "Adjusts the opacity mask based on the height map. At 1 decal is fully visible, and at 0 it goes invisible. This setting requires a valid height map on your decals.",
      "Type": "ParticleFloat",
      "Group": null,
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "CoverageRange",
      "Title": "Coverage Range",
      "Description": "Controls the smoothness of height coverage. No fade at 0, maximum fade at 0.5.",
      "Type": "Single",
      "Group": null,
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "SortLayer",
      "Title": "Sort Layer",
      "Description": "Determines the order the decal gets rendered in, the higher the layer the more priority it has. Decals on the same layer get automatically sorted by their GameObject ID.",
      "Type": "UInt32",
      "Group": null,
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "SheetSequence",
      "Title": "Sheet",
      "Description": null,
      "Type": "Boolean",
      "Group": null,
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "SequenceId",
      "Title": "Sequence Id",
      "Description": "Which sequence to use",
      "Type": "UInt32",
      "Group": null,
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "OnComponentEnabled",
      "Title": "On Component Enabled",
      "Description": null,
      "Type": "Action",
      "Group": "Component",
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "OnComponentStart",
      "Title": "On Component Start",
      "Description": null,
      "Type": "Action",
      "Group": "Component",
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "OnComponentUpdate",
      "Title": "On Component Update",
      "Description": null,
      "Type": "Action",
      "Group": "Component",
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "OnComponentFixedUpdate",
      "Title": "On Component Fixed Update",
      "Description": null,
      "Type": "Action",
      "Group": "Component",
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "OnComponentDisabled",
      "Title": "On Component Disabled",
      "Description": null,
      "Type": "Action",
      "Group": "Component",
      "ReadOnly": false
    },
    {
      "Name": "OnComponentDestroy",
      "Title": "On Component Destroy",
      "Description": null,
      "Type": "Action",
      "Group": "Component",
      "ReadOnly": false
    }
  ]
}
